entries.title: Cards open with pictures and fold their long text
entries.body: Your first mate and crew now lead a card with its answer and a picture for each part, with the numbers drawn in the picture and one sentence beside it. Reasons, steps, caveats, a plan's details and evidence sit in named sections you open when you want them.
entries.noPicture: This changes how your first mate and crew write each card, so no one screen of the app shows it before and after.
